primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

wikipediaCheck.evidenceLocator: A–K list, “Alameth”, lines 652–656: son of Becher, matching 1 Chronicles 7:8; distinct from the Alemeth entry immediately below.
